# Official upgrade v0.2.14

- Target: `v0.2.14`.

- Official tag and commit: `v0.2.14` / `0363b8cdba8cec3e2ba4b2dbd49c4481143fa55d`.
- Previous Vendor baseline: `vendor-0.2.13` / `3040209f205472038c1ba745a1bedd2edd9053b1`.
- Upgrade branch: `upgrade/v0.2.14`.
- Upgrade mode: common history confirmed; official `v0.2.14` was merged with `git merge --no-ff`.
- Official increment: 25 files, `+775/-162`; the payment provider, payment resume service, deployment files, and frontend dependency files overlap existing Custom changes and were reviewed.

## Custom changes

- Preserved the Custom EasyPay native BEpusdt protocol, network validation, cancellation behavior, and payment resume/load-balancer bridges while carrying the official EasyPay callback allowlist and return URL canonicalization fix.
- Preserved the public Custom repository, image/runtime persistence, Compose overlay, updater, and backup-first deployment instructions while documenting the new generated admin login behavior.
- Kept the Custom dependency audit policy limited to the two active xlsx exceptions, updated their expiry and rationale from the official security fix, and retained the public repository owner.
- Accepted the official fresh-install admin credential hardening and remote Codex API-key model-discovery configuration without changing existing deployments or Custom business orchestration.

## Database

- No official migration, schema, Ent schema, entity-field, index, constraint, or SQL file changed between `vendor-0.2.13` and `v0.2.14`.
- No production DDL or DML was executed.
- Before deployment, run read-only checks against `schema_migrations`, `information_schema.columns`, `pg_indexes`, and the existing Custom database-boundary checks; no forward migration is required for this version.

## Validation

- Reviewed all 25 official changed files and the 13 overlapping Custom paths; no payment, inventory, order, callback, or database contract was removed.
- Passed `go test -count=1 ./internal/payment/provider ./internal/service ./internal/setup` (provider, service, and setup packages).
- Passed frontend lint, typecheck, the 21-file critical Vitest set (339 tests), Custom Vitest (33 files, 167 tests), and the production build.
- Passed the Custom delta/thin-bridge ledger (648 decisions), final database-boundary check, rehearsal Compose safety, release safety, and upstream-sync safety checks. The final Custom database fingerprint was `e2aa6d2fa7261d06ee832748ba6e016f05f973a0b05563ea1c487aaa9b4b8a61`; it is an already registered Custom database surface, not a new official migration.
- A diagnostic full frontend Vitest run reported 373 files/2820 passing tests and 8 inherited or expectation-drift failures in the existing settings quota, subscription assignment, and Codex configuration suites; the required CI critical/custom suites pass, and the official Codex configuration change is retained.
- Full production database, server restart, live health, and business acceptance remain separate post-release operations.

## Release and rollback

- Candidate baseline is bound to `vendor-0.2.14` / `0363b8cdba8cec3e2ba4b2dbd49c4481143fa55d`; the immutable Vendor tag is created only by the trusted upgrade finalizer after the exact PR is merged.
- Custom Release publication must target the exact merged `main` SHA and separately verify CI, boundaries, checksums, manifest, and OCI digests.
- Production installation, restart, migration completion, health checks, runtime SHA, and business traffic acceptance remain separate post-release actions.
